page.layout: One printed page with a decorative rule at top; main contents list in the centre; a torn left-hand page edge with partial text in the left margin (not transcribed as main text, only the visible fragments noted); catchword/signature line at foot.

main_text.head: Contenta hujus opusculi.
main_text.l: 1. Technometria omnium & singularum artium limites adæquatè circumscribens, prima.
2. Alia Technometriæ delineatio per quæstiones & responsiones ad faciliorem captum instituta ac propositæ, secunda.
4. Disputatio Theologica de perfectione SS. Scripturæ in qua Ethicæ vulgaris imperfectio & inutilitas detegitur.

page.notes: The left margin carries a torn strip of an adjoining page with fragments of running text (e.g. "striâ", "hic", "ac", "com-", "Vale", "ilosfo-", "ferit"); these are the edge of the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. Ornamental rule at top is not text. Long s rendered as s; the first-line numerals are printed as superscript-style marks. Number 1 and 2 entries: printed numbers are the list markers "1.", "2.", etc. The page number "In" appears as a bottom-right catchword-like signature word and is recorded as printed.
